# 33audio

> 33audio in Houston, TX sells NOS Caddock Micronox film resistors in the MM177, MM215, MS151, and MS176 series. These resistors are liquidation stock from a Caddock stocking distributor that closed in the 1980s. Price is $10.00 each. $6.35 flat shipping for any quantity, USA only. USA orders only, no international at this time

Seller: Mark (mark@33audio.com). eBay store: https://www.ebay.com/str/33audiomarko. Caddock High Performance Film Resistors. Temperature Range to 275 deg/C max Made in USA 100% Tested Ideal For Harsh Environments

Caddock marks Type MM Not Recommended for New Designs and points new designs to Type MS.

## Catalog files

- [All parts (Markdown)](https://exergy-connect.github.io/33audio.com/catalog.md): Table of every value, tolerance, quantity, and price
- [All parts (JSON)](https://exergy-connect.github.io/33audio.com/catalog.json): The same catalog as JSON
- [Full text for agents](https://exergy-connect.github.io/33audio.com/llms-full.txt): One summary sentence per part, plus the shared FAQ
- [Catalog vocabulary](https://exergy-connect.github.io/33audio.com/schema/README.md): Every field of catalog.json with its schema.org and Wikidata mapping
- [Catalog JSON Schema](https://exergy-connect.github.io/33audio.com/schema/catalog.schema.json): JSON Schema 2020-12 generated by xYang from the YANG model
- [Catalog JSON-LD context](https://exergy-connect.github.io/33audio.com/schema/context.jsonld): Maps catalog.json keys to schema.org and the c33 vocabulary

## Series

- [MM177](https://exergy-connect.github.io/33audio.com/series/mm177/): 31 values, B tolerance unless noted otherwise
- [MM215](https://exergy-connect.github.io/33audio.com/series/mm215/): 25 values, F tolerance unless noted otherwise
- [MS151](https://exergy-connect.github.io/33audio.com/series/ms151/): 20 values, F-tolerance unless noted otherwise
- [MS176](https://exergy-connect.github.io/33audio.com/series/ms176/): 9 values, F-tolerance unless noted otherwise
